title: Si tuviera la oportunidad: hipótesis presente y futura
goal: Construct second conditional structures (si + imperfecto de subjuntivo + condicional simple) to hypothesize about unlikely or counterfactual present/future scenarios.
grammar: Oraciones condicionales potenciales: si con imperfecto de subjuntivo

sections.title: Unit 9: Conditionals I — Lesson 1
body: Welcome to lesson 1 of Unit 9 (Conditionals I: Potential Scenarios). Mastering hypothetical conditionals enables you to explore alternatives, negotiate terms, and calibrate diplomatic courtesy.
In this lesson, we study si tuviera la oportunidad: hipótesis presente y futura, establishing rigorous command of imperfect subjunctive and conditional correlatives.

items: Construct second conditional structures (si + imperfecto de subjuntivo + condicional simple) to hypothesize about unlikely or counterfactual present/future scenarios.
Incorporate advanced negotiation vocabulary (la hipótesis, inverosímil).
